title: Packing message parameters
description:
Pack and unpack the `wParam` and `lParam` values that messages carry.

```
WM_MOUSEMOVE lParam 0x00C8012C -> x 300, y 200
off-screen mouse lParam 0xFFF6FFF0 -> x -16, y -10 (signed!)
MAKELPARAM(300, 200) = 0x00C8012C
WM_SIZE lParam 0x02580320 -> width 800, height 600
```
requirements: `getX` and `getY` that read the parts as signed 16-bit numbers, like `GET_X_LPARAM`.
Show why `LOWORD` is wrong for mouse positions on a second monitor to the left.
stretch: Decode a `WM_KEYDOWN` lParam: repeat count, scan code, extended key, previous state. The bit layout is in lesson 2.01 (or look up "keystroke message flags" on Microsoft Learn).
